title: Development of a RP-HPLC method for determination of glucose in Shewanella oneidensis cultures utilizing 1-phenyl-3-methyl-5-pyrazolone derivatization

source_files.html: Development of a RP-HPLC method for determination of glucose in Shewanella oneidensis cultures utilizing 1-phenyl-3-methyl-5-pyrazolone derivatization _ PLOS One.html

chromatography_system.guard_column: YMC guard column 3 um 4.0 mm ID

method_parameters.mobile_phase_a: 15 mM potassium phosphate dibasic buffer pH 7.2
sample_prep_notes: PMP derivatization at 70 C for 90 min
Neutralize with 0.5 M HCl at 4 C

retention_entities.name: PMP-glucose
retention_entities.notes: Final peak of interest in selected method

ambiguities_and_pitfalls: The paper title says glucose but the chromatographic analyte is derivatized PMP-glucose.
The paper mixes final analytical method, derivatization procedure, and biological application details.
The return-to-initial composition is implied by equilibration and not explicitly listed in the gradient table.
must_not_extract: Do not treat optimization trial conditions as the final method.
Do not treat microbial growth conditions as chromatographic method parameters.
